# Version 4.152.2
> **GPU failure handling fixes** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.202/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and upload failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Flush failures propagate through native rendering** — Separates task execution from success and propagates task, flush, and submission failures. Existing C and managed flush operations remain ABI-compatible void calls. ([#5069](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5069))
- **Failed GPU uploads no longer feed stale draws** — Ganesh checks failed buffer uploads and initialization under memory pressure instead of drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt. ([#5117](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5117))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BA2007** — Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. ([#5121](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5121))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.202

Windows native assets correct the warning suppression that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures. This package revision does not upgrade native HarfBuzz or change its shaping behavior.
